intro: In-N-Out is the California burger chain with a famously short menu and a cult following, built on fresh, never-frozen beef, hand-cut fries and real ice cream shakes. The whole menu is the Double-Double, the cheeseburger, the hamburger, fries and shakes, but the not-so-secret menu (Animal Style, 3x3, 4x4, Protein Style and the Flying Dutchman) is half the fun. Below is the full In-N-Out menu with prices and calories for 2026.
quick_answer: A Double-Double at In-N-Out is about $5.65, a cheeseburger is $3.95, and a hamburger is $3.20. Fries are $2.45, a shake is $3.45, and a Double-Double combo runs about $10.15. Everything can be ordered Animal Style or Protein Style from the secret menu. A Double-Double is about 670 calories.
hot_deal: In-N-Out value: prices are low to begin with and the chain runs no app or loyalty deals, which is part of its appeal. The hamburger ($3.20) and cheeseburger ($3.95) are among the cheapest fresh-beef burgers anywhere. The secret menu (Animal Style, Protein Style) costs little to nothing extra. Prices vary by location.

faqs.q: How much is a Double-Double at In-N-Out?
faqs.a: A Double-Double is about $5.65, and a combo with fries and a drink is around $10.15. It is In-N-Out's signature: two patties, two slices of cheese, lettuce, tomato and spread. It is about 670 calories.

faqs.q: What is Animal Style at In-N-Out?
faqs.a: Animal Style is the most famous secret-menu order. On a burger it means a mustard-cooked patty with extra spread, pickles and grilled onions. On fries it adds cheese, spread and grilled onions. It costs little to nothing extra.

faqs.q: What is on the In-N-Out secret menu?
faqs.a: The best-known off-menu orders are Animal Style (burgers and fries), the 3x3 and 4x4 (extra patties and cheese), Protein Style (lettuce wrap instead of a bun), the Flying Dutchman (two patties and cheese, nothing else) and the Neapolitan shake.

faqs.q: How many calories are in an In-N-Out burger?
faqs.a: A hamburger is about 390 calories, a cheeseburger about 480, and a Double-Double about 670. Ordering Protein Style (lettuce wrap) cuts a burger down significantly, and fries are about 395.

faqs.q: What are the most popular items at In-N-Out?
faqs.a: The best known are the Double-Double, the cheeseburger, Animal Style fries, the Neapolitan shake, and Protein Style burgers.
